tasks.short: Adjust and operate surveying instruments in the field.

steps.what: Adjust and operate surveying instruments in the field.
Check the setup before the first stored shot.
Transfer the collector file after the job.

tasks.design: Adjusting and operating the instrument stays in the field, including prisms, theodolites and distance equipment. The technician checks the setup before shots are trusted. The collector file transfers to {DATA_PLATFORM} afterwards. The transfer is not the survey.
tasks.previous_blocker: Setups were checked by habit, and the file stayed on the collector until someone remembered.
tasks.enabler_now: A file copy is a transfer. A level setup is not.
tasks.still_hard: An instrument that will not adjust, or a shot the collector did not store, stays field work.
tasks.human_edge: The technician feels a bubble that is out and a prism that was kicked.
tasks.altitude: The file arrives without a second typing. Operating the instrument and checking the setup stay.

evidence.claim: Copying a collector file is a transfer. Operating an instrument is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician adjusts, operates and checks the setup. Calculating coordinates is a different task.
Structured input: job id, instrument id, file name. Producer is the collector. A file with no job id is stored as unmatched.
Field time stays. A bad setup is not repaired by the transfer.
unknowns: Who checks a setup the technician doubts?
research_questions: How often does a collector file stay in the instrument overnight?

already_counted.description: Operating the instrument is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire unmatched files that have no job.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the instrument stores nothing, the transfer does nothing and the field work is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check map layers, mark errors and make corrections.

steps.what: Open every layer the map is supposed to include.
Check all layers, marking errors for correction.
Make the corrections on the marked errors.

tasks.design: The layer list opens on {OPS_SYSTEM}. Checking layers, marking errors and making corrections stay the technician's. A missing layer can be listed. A wrong line cannot be judged by the list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Layers were turned on from memory, and an error was found on the printed sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: A layer that is absent is a query. Whether a line is in the wrong place is not.
tasks.still_hard: A layer that is present and still wrong stays a visual check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which layer lies about the kerb.
tasks.altitude: Finding a missing layer takes less time. Marking errors and correcting them stay.

reach.task: See the errors that were marked

evidence.claim: Listing layers on a map is a query. Marking a cartographic error is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician checks and corrects. Publishing the map is a different task if someone else signs it.
Structured input: map id, layer name, error note. Producer is the map for the layer list and the technician for the error. An error with no layer is not stored.
The check is the large share and stays.
unknowns: Is there a list of layers each map must have?
Who may correct a shared layer?
research_questions: How often does a printed map show a layer that was off?

already_counted.description: Checking the layers is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire error marks after the map version changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If layers are not named, the list is empty and the technician still checks the sheet. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect source maps and previous surveys for a new survey.

steps.what: Collect previous survey data, source maps and records.
Draft a pack that cites only those sources.

loop.input: the source ids the search returned, including photographs and old surveys
loop.output: a pack that lists only those ids
loop.check: every item must be a returned id; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a gap is marked not found
loop.why_not_simpler: what is still needed in the field is the decision

steps.what: Decide what information the new survey still needs.
File the pack and the list of what is missing.

tasks.design: Previous surveys, source maps, photographs and records for the area are collected from {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}. The pack may cite only what was found. The technician decides what the new survey still needs. The file is that decision, not a completed survey.
tasks.previous_blocker: The pack was a folder built from memory, and an old survey was missed.
tasks.enabler_now: A search by area can return source ids. Knowing the gap is not a search.
tasks.still_hard: A photograph that does not show the corner, and a record that conflicts, stay a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which old survey is the one the deed meant.
tasks.altitude: Collecting known sources takes less hunting. Deciding what is still needed stays.

reach.task: Brief the field from the missing list

evidence.claim: A search that returns source ids can be listed. Deciding the field work still required cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician collects and decides the gap. Doing the field survey is a different task.
Structured input: area, source id, type, date. Producer is the store. An item with no id is not listed.
The decision is remaining time. A missing source is shown as missing.
unknowns: Are old surveys indexed by area?
research_questions: How often is a new survey started without the previous one?

already_counted.description: Deciding what is still needed is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire packs when the survey is finished.

approvals.approved_version: gap list the technician decided for that area

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If old surveys are not indexed, the search is thin and the technician still decides from what they can find. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record survey measurements, notes and sketches.

steps.what: Record survey measurements and descriptive data.
Add sketches where the measurements need a drawing.
File the notes and the sketches on the job.

tasks.design: Measurements can be booked on {OPS_SYSTEM} while the technician is still looking at the instrument. Sketches and inked tracings stay a drawing. Filing attaches the sketch to the job. A sketch is not generated from the numbers.
tasks.previous_blocker: The book was paper, and the sketch was a separate sheet that got lost.
tasks.enabler_now: A measurement with a point id can be a field. A sketch of what the numbers do not show cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A scene that only a drawing explains stays a sketch.
tasks.human_edge: The technician sees the offset the number does not describe.
tasks.altitude: Filing the book takes less chasing. Recording unusual measurements and drawing the sketch stay.

reach.task: Read the sketch with the measurements

evidence.claim: A measurement form stops a blank point id. It does not draw the sketch.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician records. Calculating coordinates from those measurements is a different task.
Structured input: point id, measurement, description. Producer is the technician in the field. A row with no point id is kept as a sketch note, not a calculation input.
Sketching time stays. The file does not redraw it.
unknowns: Will the crew book on a device in the field?
research_questions: How often is a sketch separated from its measurements?

already_counted.description: Sketching is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire notes for jobs that closed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the crew will not book in the field, the measurements are typed later and the sketch is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Layer checks, sketches and instrument setups stay the technician's. Source packs list only records that were found. The gap for a new survey is a decision, not a search result.
reach: The party chief gets a missing-source list.
Sketches sit on the same job as the measurements.
skills_to_grow: Mark a layer wrong rather than assuming the list is the map.
Say what the old survey does not cover.
role.ambitious_version: A new survey starts from a pack, and a sketch is not lost from its measurements.
